comments.author: lonelyasacloud
comments.story: Robots Have Been About to Take All the Jobs for 100 Years
comments.why: Demo turning a hand-drawn sketch into a working web page
comments.text: In one of GPT4's release demos, it is shown being fed a photograph of a hand-drawn web page. It then image analyses that, works out that it's a picture of a web page and turns it into a working web page ( [VIDEO] ). So here's the thing; what in that list of non-codegen tasks is more complicated than that which GPT can already automate?
